create_app_state: create an AppStateRearrange or AppStateRearrangeTutorialTransition instance based on the tutorial config flag
review_AppStateRearrange_sim_update: review the AppStateRearrange sim_update method which handles per-frame simulation updates, camera, and help text
review_AppStateRearrange_grasping: review the _update_grasping_and_set_act_hints method for spacebar grasp release and click-to-walk logic
review_AppStateRearrangeTutorialTransiti: review the AppStateRearrangeTutorialTransition class that manages tutorial flythrough before switching to rearrange mode
